name: fv-toolkit
description: Formal verification for real codebases. The router skill picks a tool by the question: TLA+ for orderings, crashes and retries, Alloy for relations and permissions, Hypothesis for functions over all inputs. Every check must fail on a planted bug before it counts, and every model records the commit it was read against.

interface.shortDescription: Pick the check that can settle a correctness question, and prove the check can fail.
interface.longDescription: Routes a correctness question to the cheapest formal tool that can produce the failure, writes the model or the properties from the code, requires every check to fail on a planted bug, and replays each counterexample against the real code.
defaultPrompt: Use $formal-verification to check whether two jobs can race in this code.
Use $formal-verification to check this calculation for every input.
Use $fv-maintain to see whether the models still describe the code.
